content: Nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a làkwikilà a atɔŋ a Yɛsu
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàyilyaaŋà u Ngalilɛ. Nde kàkwen anki muyilyaaŋ u Yuday, ntɔn amfum a Ayudà bàleŋà mukun'dwa.
Kyekà, un'kyɔm a ndwà a ntɛn a Ayudà kàkäl tsütsü.
Apan, atɔŋ a Yɛsu bàtɛn a nde naa: « Lwomà apà, kyen Yuday, ntɔn alɔŋki angye sye bàmɛn isal akyerà ngye bi.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ufàkyer anki undiir u nku isàkal naa nde akwen umɛnà. Ntɔn akakyerà ngye indiir abi, wɛy ngye ŋakwo sye amɛnà u mii a baar. »
Abun, atɔŋ ande ŋakwo bun'si anki làkwikilà.
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki. Wɛɛ akà bɛ, taaŋ lanswà là ubwaŋ.
Mɛɛn ikwe tɛy mukàlayiiŋ, wɛɛ mɛ, nde akyer afan'yiiŋ, ntɔn mɛ in'fàtà imbäl naa isal ande byà ibe.
Kyakin, bɛ, bɛ làbeenà un'kyɔm. Akà mɛ, mɛ in'beenà tɛy un'kyɔm, ntɔn taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki. »
Ungö mutɛn abà, nde kàsàbwaay u Ngalilɛ.
Yɛsu kà un'kyɔm a ndwà a ntɛn
Wɛɛ mpal bàkyen atɔŋ ande un'kyɔm, apan, nde sye kàbeenà aŋàyen, kà u mii a baar anki, wɛɛ asànaa u nku.
Umpal a un'kyɔm, amfum a Ayudà bàyun'leŋà ba, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Wàken nde bà? »
Baar bàsyeelà mbaaŋ mbɔɔn ntɔn nde uboo a nköŋ. Amwɛy naa: « Nde wà mbuur aŋàbwaŋ ». Wɛɛ bumwɛy naa: « Ŋaa, nde wà muyibwiy baar ndwaŋ. »
Itàkal abun, akà mbuur mwɛy kàtɛɛnà anki u mii a baar, ntɔn ba bàtiinà amfum a Ayudà bɔɔmà.
Un'kyɔm kàkäl kan'tol uboboo, Yɛsu kàbeenà ndwà a Nzam, waa kàlɔɔŋà.
Amfum a Ayudà bàmɛn ndaa yubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Aben nde uyöbà, nde mbuur mpa kàtäŋ? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « An'lɔɔŋ amɛ kà man'fà akà mɛ anki, wɛɛ màmbuur kan'töm.
Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukyer ukwen a Nzam, nde asàyöb naa nkye an'lɔɔŋ amà man'fà akà Nzam, lɛɛ mɛ in'wà mutɛn kà ikɔb amɛ ŋakwo.
Mbuur afàtɛn ntɔn nde ŋakwo, afàleŋ làkoo ande ŋakwo. Wɛɛ mbuur afàleŋ làkoo a mbuur kun'töm, nde wà mbuur a ndandaa, usɔɔr akà nde batɛy.
Nkye kà Mɔsɛ anki kàlapɛ Un'kɔɔn? Wɛɛ akà umwɛy uboo abɛ ufàsyääl anki wa. Ntɔn nkye làkwen bɛ mukan'dwa? »
Iköŋ a baar kyun'fuur naa: « Ngye awe anà un'sɔŋà! Nà akwen akadwa? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mɛ, mɛ an'kyer isal imwɛy, wɛɛ bɛ banswà, bɛ lan'bem!
Ntɔn Mɔsɛ kàlaswɛŋ mukyɛy baan abaal - ya sye yàfü anki akà Mɔsɛ, wɛɛ yàfü akà bànkaa - waa bɛ làfàkyɛy baal mwɛy ilä a saba.
Isàkal naa bɛ lan'kwo mukyɛy baal mwɛy ilä a saba ukɔɔn abɛy Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, ntɔn nkye làman'wem bɛ nkyɛl ntɔn an'kɔɔr mɛ baal aŋun'kiinà ilä a saba?
Twon lan'tsul mbar ntɔn ubwaŋ a nsà, wɛɛ làtsül mbar a balàbal. »
Nkye Yɛsu wà Klistɔ?
Ndam a baar uboo a baar a Yɛlusàlɛm bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nkye wà kà mbuur bàyileŋ ba mudwa anki?
Le, nde wàmutɛn u mii a baar, wɛɛ akà mbuur a un'sà nso watɛy! Nkye amfum abi ban'kyey naa ndandaa nde wà Klistɔ?
Mpal usàyà Klistɔ, akà mbuur mwɛy usàyöb anki ntsü kan'fà nde. Wɛɛ baal wà, bi ikyàyöb ntsü kan'fà nde. »

Apan, umpal kàlɔɔŋà Yɛsu u ndwà a Nzam, nde kàsi un'kwɛŋ: « Bɛ, bɛ làkyan'yöb! Bɛ làkyàyöb ntsü an'fà mɛ! Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàyi anki mɛ ŋakwo, mbuur awà kan'töm wà ndandaa. Bɛ, bɛ lun'yöb anki.
Mɛ, mɛ in'kyun'yöb, ntɔn mɛ kàfü akà nde, nde sye kan'töm. »
Apan, ba bàleŋ mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ akà mbuur kun'bä anki, ntɔn taaŋ ande làkäl aŋàkwo anki.
Uboo a iköŋ, baar mbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà amu nde. Ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nkye mpal usàyà Klistɔ, nde asàkyer impà aŋàsöön abyà ukyerà mbuur wà? »
Aseey ntɔn mukɔr Yɛsu
In'ŋün myàkäl uboo a iköŋ a baar ntɔn Yɛsu, myàyàböl kà an'tsü a Amfarisi. Apan, andwer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi waa bàtöm aseey ntɔn mukun'kɔr.
Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ in'wà anà bɛ taaŋ ikikye, ungö mɛ in'kyà ntsü akà mbuur kan'töm.
Bɛ làkyer asan'leŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsan'man tɛy, ntɔn bɛ làkwe anki muyà kà ikal in'sàkal mɛ. »

Fà apan, amfum a Ayudà bàsɛmà mufuul ba a ba naa: « Nde apɛy ayàkyà ken ntɔn bi ifàkɔɔn un'man? Nkye nde apɛy ayàkàtaan Ayudà akwà bàpää uboo a Angɛlɛki? Nkye nde apɛy Angɛlɛki usàkàlɔŋ?
Ikaswaŋà aben ndaa utɛn nde ayɛy naa: "Bɛ, bɛ làkyer asan'leŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsan'man tɛy, naa sye bɛ làkwe tɛy muyà kà ikal in'sàkal mɛ"? »
Ngyäl a an'dà a mɔ̈ɔ̈
Ilä a ntsüü a un'kyɔm kyàkäl ilä mwɛy kyà kölàköl. Yɛsu kàkäl umbär wàmukyäänà naa: « Isàkal naa mbuur we anà mfwää, wɛy nde uyi akà mɛ, waa unwà.
Mbuur awe anà làkwikilà amu mɛ, "ngyäl a an'dà a mɔ̈ɔ̈ isàtoo u mpem ande", asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn. »
Kàtɛɛnà nde abunà, yà ntɔn Dweelà bàlàwal baar bàlàsà làkwikilà aba amu nde. Umpal ayin, Dweelà kàkäl aŋàtàpà anki, ntɔn Yɛsu kàkäl anki aŋàtàwal làkoo.
Iköŋ kyan'kaabà ntɔn Yɛsu
Amwɛy uboo iköŋ bàwem ndaa ayi, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ndandaa mbuur awà, wà Ŋangɔɔm! »
Bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nde wà Klistɔ! » – Wɛɛ bumwɛy bàfuur naa: « Nkye Klistɔ sye an'kwo utoo u Ngalilɛ?
Nkye Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛɛnà anki naa nde asàkal mbuur a ywar a David, nde asàfà Bɛtelɛm, bul kàkälà David? »
Apan, iköŋ kyàkaabà ntɔn nde.
Amwɛy uboo a ba bàkweenà naa bun'kör, wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mukun'ba.
Nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a làkwikilà a amfum a Ayudà
Aseey bàyàfurà ba akà andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi, ba bafuul naa: « Ntɔn nkye mpa làtwääl bɛ Yɛsu? »
Aseey bàfuur naa: « Akà mbuur mwɛy ŋàtàtɛn anki akà ikikye asànaa nde! » –
Apan, Amfarisi bafuul naa: « Nkye anà bɛ sye, nde akyàlabwiy ndwaŋ?
Nkye we anà umwɛy uboo a amfum itàkal uboo a Amfarisi, kàsi làwikilà amu nde?
Wɛɛ baar abà, baar mpa bàyöb Un'kɔɔn akà ikikye, ba bàŋàküül! »
Wɛɛ umwɛy uboo a Amfarisi, Nàkàdim akwà kàkàman Yɛsu itaan, kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Nkye Un'kɔɔn abi afàtsüül mbuur mbar ukɔɔn atun'wem anà muyöb naa nde nkye kan'kyer? »
Ba bun'fuur naa: « Nkye ngye sye awà un'nsi Ngalilɛ? Leŋ, ngye ayàman naa akà ŋangɔɔm mwɛy ufàtoo anki u Ngalilɛ akà ikikye. »
Ungö apan, mbuur mbuur kàfurà ndwà ande.
